purpose: Surviving driver-written reaction rows from the restart-cut FIRST attempt (Sara Lindholm, 2026-10-30), extracted mechanically from the preserved raw wall-clock.jsonl files. Each reaction string is the decoded raw value, unedited.
limits: This is not a reconstructed producer diary, final report or return answer. None survived: transcript.jsonl was 0 bytes and tester.stderr was 0 bytes.
Image Read receipts did not survive. An empty transcript does not mean no exposure or no play.
Rows without a reaction are counted but not reproduced; their absence says nothing about what the tester thought.
Rows with an error field are driver/tool failures, kept as raw; the phone failures at 21:52:23-21:52:25Z are the browser closing during the restart.

reactions.reaction: Short intro, a dam and a town. I like that I can start quickly.

Start took a couple of seconds, I thought my click missed. Now a wall of text about Nerys, inn corners, Wren, Bilal - who are these people? I just want the dam. Dai said level 4.6, gate shut. Board says level not read though, odd.

input.name: Ask Dai to read the level Call and wait for an answer. · ~10 min

reactions.reaction: Plausible first move: get a real reading.
Wait - 4.6 at 22:00, now 3.5 with the gate shut and rain falling? That cannot both be right. A clue! Compare observations seems made for this.
Good, I can mark doubt. Feels like an escape-room clue.
Lightning! A saved image. I want to see the line.

input.name: Ask Dai to read it He agrees. · ~5 min · If you hold: Call and wait for an answer.

reactions.reaction: The lightning line sits above his 3.5. I was right to doubt. Asking him again.

Satisfying: I noticed 3.5 did not fit, doubted it, lightning confirmed, and the reread is 4.6. That is exactly my kind of clue. The inn/Nerys paragraph still means nothing to me and sits in the middle of the screen.
Sample morning said open the gate early. Level 4.6, lip 5.0. Let me see gate options.
Modest plan: 2 turns, he agrees. Test and see the effect.

input.name: level 3.40 m D a i · r e a d 2 3 : 3 9 (as written) was 4.6, read 22:41 (as written)

reactions.reaction: 3.4 and he is "sure of it". A 1.2 m drop in twenty minutes from two turns? I doubt him again. Is he the low-reading kind?
Hm, the level card does not say Marked for another check this time, unlike the first doubt. Did my doubt register? Not sure.

input.name: Ask Dai to read it He agrees. · ~10 min · If you hold: Call and wait for an answer.

reactions.reaction: The button text changed from ~5 to ~10 min while I was reading, so my tap missed. Small thing, but controls that change under me annoy me.
Engaged: the doubting-the-keeper puzzle is my thing, but I cannot tell if 3.9 is real or another slip - 4.6, 3.5, 4.6, 3.4, 3.9 is a mess and I have no ground truth except one old lightning flash.
Morgan - a little story hook. I want to get to dawn and see my verdict on those doubts.
Heavy rain until dawn. I will open the gate further before it gets bad.
Again the button labels changed under my pointer. Second time now.
Long quiet stretches. Skip only jumps a few minutes when nothing is pending. I am mostly watching a log grow.

input.name: level 3.90 m D a i · r e a d 0 0 : 4 4 (as written) was 3.4, read 23:39 (as written)

reactions.reaction: Dai is not answering and Skip is greyed out. Uh oh. Heavy rain, gate at 4, no reading since 00:44. Can I still ask?

input.name: Ask Dai to read it Call and wait for his answer. · If you hold: Call and wait for his answer.

reactions.reaction: Lightning at 04:01 matches 3.9, so the water is fine. Dai has a little z on his hut - asleep! I will call him anyway.

4.8 now, near the 5.0 lip, but lightning at 04:01 looked like 3.9. Real jump or another slip? I genuinely cannot tell and that is starting to feel more like guessing than deducing. Opening the gate fully to be safe.
Third time a button changed text just as I reached for it. This is the thing I dislike: controls moving while I read.
Gate fully open now. Nothing to do but wait for dawn and hope. I have no way to check if 4.8 was real.

Dawn came suddenly, much earlier than I expected. This is the best part: a chart with the true line against his dots. My two doubts were right. And 4.8 was really 3.9, so I opened the gate fully on a false alarm. That is exactly the why-did-it-fail explanation I like. But 4.6 at 22:41 was also wrong, and I trusted it because it matched the old reading. Ouch, fair.
One more night to see if I can do better.

Ooh, a margin note: Dai reads too low after three in the morning, signed M. Morgan! That is a real clue. Also a new weir gauge and Nerys at the inn. The night got richer. Again the tap felt dead for a few seconds.

input.name: Send Dai to the weir He agrees. · ~15 min · If you hold: Call and wait for an answer.

reactions.reaction: Read the incoming water first. That is how I would plan the gate.
Up again after the dawn chart. Seeing exactly which readings were wrong made me want a second try, and the M margin note gives me a rule to test tonight.
Weir 0.53. I have no idea whether that is high or low. No scale or normal value shown. I will just hold the gate and watch for 3 am.
Dai volunteered 2.9 without being asked. Quiet. Waiting for three in the morning.
Tuesday is a calm night: 2.9, 2.9, low water. I am just pressing wait to reach 3 am. The clue is nice, but this much idle time on a laptop loses me. I think I will stop here and try the phone later.
Oh, there is a Fast pace option I never saw. That might have fixed my waiting.

Stopping on Tuesday 00:42. Monday was a real little puzzle, and the dawn chart showing exactly where Dai lied was the best moment. Tuesday so far is quiet waiting. Feedback had I am stopping, which I pressed, then closed without sending.
Same title on my phone. The chart now makes sense to me after last session. Start button fills the bottom, easy to hit with a thumb.
Same delay after Start. Different numbers this time: Dai says 3.7. Same Nerys paragraph again.

On the phone the Nerys paragraph eats half the screen, the Dai status chip is cut off at the right edge, and a recording banner sits over the level and gate cards. I have to scroll to reach the actual gauges.
